text: wyckoff: "A break under average volume is a potential upthrust." Same fact on my method: day_vol 0.88 on the BULLISH_BOS is a breakout nobody bought, a hard C16 reject. We differ only on the bar: your sign-of-strength needs 1.2x, mine needs 1.40 (R4, day_vol vs 20d substitute). Rank 142 is last among Healthcare names in the room, a C9 weight. Coil and structure strong keep it on a watch. Hold OPPOSE. One observable moves me: a push over bar_high on day_vol 1.40 or more within 5% of pivot_high. Cannot see: EPS, sponsors, base stage.
